//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the FORM-LABEL component — the field label (keen `PureAdmin.Components.Form.form_label/1`, svelte `forms/FormLabel.svelte`). SCOPE = the single bare `<label for="…">text</label>` both wrappers emit. CRITICAL: there is NO `.pa-form-label` class in core — a <label> inside `.pa-form .pa-form-group` is auto-styled by the cascade (snippets/forms.html:529-532, 20-23). So this is an intentionally CLASS-LESS component: the block `pa-form-label` matches zero selectors in main.css (the axis-1 vacuous-scope note is expected and benign — this is the legit class-less case the guard calls out, like inline <code>). The required asterisk is ATTRIBUTE-DRIVEN by core (`.pa-form-group:has(:required) > label::after`), so neither wrapper hand-renders a marker — keen's `is_required` / svelte's (absent) required are no-ops with no class. Only `for` + optional passthrough `class` are real output. See label.json (the pa-label badge, a DIFFERENT component) for contrast — form-label is NOT that.

propsVocabulary.forAttr: native `for` attribute associating the label with a control id
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough; note the label has no base class of its own

goldenConventions: Structural only. The label is a plain <label> with an optional `for` attribute and whatever passthrough class is given (no base class is ever emitted — there is no pa-form-label). The body is a plain text token. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away. Note: when no class is passed, svelte emits `class={undefined}` (no attribute) — the empty-class case the normalizer drops anyway.

features.//: Feature→class contract. There is NO pa-form-label CSS class, so EVERY feature here is `produces: null` (native `for` attr, slot text, or raw class passthrough). The block matching nothing in main.css is expected (class-less component).

extraClass.note: class passthrough — the label has no base class
